reviews.comment: A really good person, I did not deserve the extensions he gave me, but I did better work because he treated me like a real human being unlike other professors who I don't think even saw me or acknowledged my situation.

Great prof, great guy. Clearly is passionate about the subject and tried hard to connect to students not of his generation. He frequently incorporates memes and youtube videos in his lectures and is easy to take notes from because he talks so much. Truly is my favorite professor I've had in my college career thus far as a junior.

Professor Bitgood is a genuinely good guy who cares about his students. He does everything he can to make you succeed. And he makes the lectures funny and interesting. However, it certainly isn't an easy class. Every week there is a lot of reading and writing assigned. It can be hard to keep up with but It's still a great class.

I honestly really enjoyed this class. He is really engaging and is actually funny. He has weekly journal entries, but it was helpful because it motivated me to do the readings. There were random pop quizzes. 3 essays.

Great professor. He is easily accessible during office hours and usually responds to emails fairly quickly. Lots of reading was assigned but the lectures always manage to make the material engaging. He's got a good sense of humor as well. Put in the effort and you should come out with an A. Would definitely take a class with him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Absolutely hilarious prof! Loved being in his class. His lectures are engaging and fun, but be sure you're reading - he likes pop quizzes. To be honest, it was a pretty good amount of work (i.e., a lot of writing) for one class but it was a good time so I didn't mind. Super approachable and chill, I'd recommend him!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof Bitgood was awesome and an incredibly engaging professor. His lectures were great, and he did a good job trying to engage students. No wrong answers, only new ideas with him. There was a new reading every class, but it was reasonable for the course level, at an hour a night. My favorite part of this class was how personal he was with feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Awesome guy! Readings are a bit overwhelming, but he makes it worthwhile with great lectures and 3 not-so-hard papers if you know how to make&back up an argument.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I usually HATE english so I dreaded this class. To my luck professor Bitgood's lectures were super engaging and I did not even feel like I was in an english class. He is super helpful with feedback on papers and the papers aren't too bad! The pre class reading was also not too bad and he does not grade you on it you just need it to participate.

Overall not a difficult class, but dude takes forever to grade and sometimes assigns dozens of chapters to read before each class. He pretty much gave up on posting lectures or communicating with the class once it went online. I enjoyed the readings and the lectures in class, but I was often frustrated with how things turned out toward the end.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Genuinely the best lecturer I have had in my four years. Professor Bitgood is engaging and inspiring in a way that I had not encountered in all of the classes that I have taken. He engages the class in a way that genuinely make you want to be there, and he REALLY cares about his students! English major or not, do yourself a favor and take his class

His lectures are amazing and make learning so fun. He is very inspiring. Most of the time, he plays YouTube videos help convey ideas in the lecture which makes the class not so boring. Peer reviews during class before an essay is great. Also, when he asks for someone to give their thesis for an essay, do it. Yall work on it in class and can use it.

I highly recommend Professor Bitgood if youre taking ENGL 104! I think hes a fair grader and is always available if you have questions about any of the prompts. The only grades in this class are 3 essays and an annotated bibliography. If you utilize the writing center and communicate with him youll be fine.

His lectures are funny and enjoyable. His essays are relatively easy but he is a little tough with grading. If you want a good time in class this is your professor. If you want an easy A without going to the writing center look somewhere else.
He has interesting lectures but he is highly unclear of what he wants in his papers. He grades extremely hard like we were majoring in the subject. He was caring about the students
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I really like Professor Bitgood. He always made class interesting, and he's available to talk to after class. And he freaking loves poetry for some reason
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof Bitgood was one of my favorite this semester. He makes lectures as interesting as he can (keep in mind it's an English class), and he also really cares about his students. You only have 3 papers, so every one of them counts, but he's a very fair grader. He also allows rewrites if you want to put in the extra work. Would recommend to everyone!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Would take again

reviews.comment: Grades based off grammar mainly so if you have that down you will get an A easy. Lets you do rewrites for your papers... however grading is slow and grading rewrites is even slower. Only time you can access him is during his office hours. Lectures go off on tangents all the time.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
